decisions.reason: A cheap accessory with almost no holding cost that complements the trailer range, so there is little reason to give up this option even after several years.
After four years the car transporter's niche demand should be clearer, but shared production keeps holding costs low, so keeping it is justified unless results are clearly poor.
Low-bed trailers are a core category once featured on the home page, and the resolved uncertainty most likely confirms their value as part of the established range.
High-cover variants build cheaply on existing trailer platforms and keep upside open at minimal cost.
With the overlapping series B already withdrawn, F has become the firm's consolidated box trailer line, so the consolidation risk has largely gone.
